what: the first fine-tuning run, jurkat / own_trainable, superseded
why_kept: the evidence that the checkpoint selection rule was wrong: the quantity it selected on falls monotonically while the training loss falls, so it picked epoch 1 and early-stopped at 11
recipe: scGPT Tutorial_Perturbation, Adam 1e-4, batch 64, StepLR 0.9, clip 1.0, amp, 15 epochs, early stop 10
selection_rule_used: mean per-perturbation Pearson between the model's own flag-on-minus-flag-off response and the measured response over 41 validation perturbations
selection_rule_correct: lowest masked-MSE on held-out validation cells (what the tutorial selects on)

forward_pass_sample.input: a randomly drawn non-targeting control cell, log1p CP10K over the sampled genes
forward_pass_sample.target: the perturbed cell's own expression, log1p CP10K over the same genes
